Financial Supervisory Service
www.fss.or.kr
 
January 12, 2008 
Expected Changes to Corporate Disclosures Following the Enactment of the 
Capital Market and Financial Investment Business Act 
With the February 4, 2009 enactment of the Capital Market and Financial Investment 
Business Act, changes in the regulations related to corporate disclosures are followed. 
The major changes are listed in the tables below. 
Disclosures of Primary Offerings 
 Securities & Exchange Act Capital Market & Financial 
Investment Business Act 
Expansion of registration 
requirements 
Positive listing 
(Investment contract 
securities, collective 
investment securities, etc. 
were enumerate) 
Negative listing 
(With the expansion they are 
now included) 
Discontinuation of 
Registration of Securities 
Issuances 
All public offerings of 
securities, and cases where 
non-listed companies are 
planning to merge with listed 
companies must be registered 
with the FSC 
FSC registration is no longer 
required 
Lowering of the Small 
Offering Standard 
Any public offering under 
KRW2 billion could be 
registered with the FSC using 
the small offering registration 
form 
Any public offering under 
KRW1 billion could be 
registered with the FSC using 
the small offering registration 
form 
Duty to Distribute Prospectus 
The prospectus was only 
distributed when personally 
requested by investors during 
public offerings and selling of 
securities 
Prospectus must always be 
distributed to investors before 
public offerings and selling of 
securities 
Disclosure of Secondary Offering 
 Securities & Exchange Act Capital Market and Financial 
Investment Business Act 
Changes to Submission 
Requirements of Annual 
Business Reports 
A FSC-registered corporation 
with 500 or more 
shareholders 
A corporation subject to 
external audit with 500 or 
more shareholders 
Adoption of Material Fact 
Report 
A listed company must report 
to the FSC and the Korea 
Exchange of any material 
facts with regards to its 
management 
Reporting of material facts 
must be classified and 
submitted accordingly as 
material fact report(FSC) and 
ongoing disclosure 
duties(Korea Exchange) 
Press Release

Financial Supervisory Service
www.fss.or.kr
 
 
 
 
Disclosure for Equity Ownership 
 
 
Contact Persons: 
Kook Hwan Cho Bum-Yoal Lee 
Deputy Director Associate Director 
Corporate Disclosure System Office International Cooperation Department 
Financial Supervisory Service Financial Supervisory Service 
(02) 3786-8434 (02) 3786-7910 
 
Securities & Exchange Act Capital Market and Financial 
Investment Business Act 
Reporting of large share 
acquisitions (5% rule) 
Settlement Date (T+7) Transaction Date (T+5) 
Duty to send a report to the 
issuer (5% rule) 
Not Applicable Must report to the issuer a 
copy of the report stating the 
number of stock he holds, etc 
Expansion of scope of 
securities required for 
reporting by executives and 
significant shareholders 
Stocks Stocks, CB, BW, EB, etc. 
Expansion of executives and 
significant shareholders 
required for reporting 
Registered directors or 
officers 
Officers(or executives), 
including those persons 
falling under each 
subparagraph of Art.401-2 of 
the Commercial Act 
Shortening of reporting period 
by directors and significant 
shareholders 
Within 10 days from the day 
on which he/she became an 
executive or a significant 
shareholder, or within 10 days 
from the day on which any 
change occurred in the status 
of securities he/she holds 
Within 5 days from the day on 
which he/she became an 
executive or a significant 
shareholder, or within 5 days 
from the day on which any 
change occurred in the status 
of securities he/she holds
